Welcome—let’s take a moment to imagine how every economic decision, whether big or small, sends out ripples that touch lives in ways we might not even realize.
Have you ever wondered what really happens when a new policy is rolled out, or why some solutions seem to bring more problems in their wake?
Together, we’re about to explore these questions and more, drawing inspiration from Henry Hazlitt’s insightful work, Economics in One Lesson.
Hazlitt invites us to look beyond the obvious, to see not just the quick fixes or short-term gains, but the hidden consequences that ripple through time and affect everyone—not just one group, but all of us, and not just today, but far into the future.
As we dive into real-world examples like taxes, government spending, and price controls, you’ll discover how simple choices can lead to surprising outcomes—and why it’s so important to look beneath the surface.
By walking this path together, we’ll build a new habit: thinking deeply about how incentives, costs, and benefits weave together across the entire economic landscape.
So, if you’re curious about what really drives the economy and want to see the unseen forces at work, you’re in the right place. Let’s set out on this journey and uncover how economic forces shape our everyday lives—often in ways we never expected.
